title: Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Extension, Solid Brass - Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Need a place to hang a robe or towel in the bathroom—but don’t want a hook protruding into your space? The Carolina retractable wall hook extends when you need it and pushes back in when you don’t.

  • Clear the walkway: retractable rod pulls out for use, then retracts to sit out of the way
  • Keep daily items handy: creates 2-1/2 inches of hanging space for towels, robes, or clothing
  • Coordinate the room: part of the Carolina collection for matching Carolina, classic bath accessories, and traditional bathroom hardware
  • Make it yours: swap the supplied knob tip for your own cabinet knob to match existing hardware
  • Built for real use: brass construction rated to hold up to 15 lb when installed as directed

Specs & Installation

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Hanging space (extension): 2-1/2"
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 1.75" x 1.75" x 3.75"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Fits standard interior walls
  • Installation: drill a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall and 3 small holes around; mounting hardware included (6/32 toggles)
  • Assembly required: No

Finish shown may vary by selection; multiple designer finish options are available.
